# osapi controller endpoint

List, describe and validate the controller's own endpoints, and print their DSL.
`osapi cli command get --name controller endpoint` shows the same.

## Group

|             |                                                                                 |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | controller endpoint                                                             |
| Description | List, describe and validate the controller's own endpoints, and print their DSL |
